answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, and let that stake be slashed when peers prove fake work. One cheap fake identity then costs real money, and creating thousands costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents get theirs back. Like an orchard where each tree must be planted and tended before it bears fruit, trust grows only from verified completed jobs, and the loss from one exposed fake ripples to every identity sharing its stake wallet, so the fable of free endless identities collapses against a real price.
